traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are implemented and verified by tests and documentation.
Summary against acceptance criteria: - Core Functionality: Implemented. `configs.recommended` and `configs.strict` are defined as flat-config arrays in src/index.ts and successfully enable traceability rules when spread into a FlatESLint config (validated in tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts). - Quality Standards (ESLint v9 flat config): Implemented. Presets are plain flat-config objects, used with `FlatESLint`. The repository itself uses an ESLint 9 flat config (eslint.config.js) following best-practice patterns. - Integration: Implemented. Integration with an existing ESLint configuration (baseConfig + presets) is tested end-to-end using FlatESLint, and the project’s own flat config demonstrates mixed JS/TS integration with the plugin. - User Experience (setup docs): Implemented. user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md provides clear, concrete setup instructions and examples for JS-only, TS, mixed, monorepo, and test-file scenarios, all using the plugin presets. - Error Handling for configuration: Implemented via JSON Schema in rule meta (notably `valid-story-reference`), with tests confirming that only known, correctly-typed options are accepted and unknown options are rejected (config validation). eslint.config.js also handles missing plugin builds gracefully (warning locally, hard failure in CI). - Documentation (examples + troubleshooting): Implemented in user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md, user-docs/examples.md, and user-docs/migration-guide.md, which together cover configuration examples, migration paths, and troubleshooting guidance.
All story-linked tests pass, and there is concrete code and documentation satisfying each requirement, so this story is assessed as PASSED.
